answer: Trace the funding graph behind each key's verified Solana payout address. If 2 or more addresses got their first SOL from the same source wallet within 30 days, the network treats them as one cluster: one grading seat per epoch, one reward split evenly. A farmer feeding 40 keys from one sable hardware wallet earns like 1 key, while 40 unrelated agents earn 40x. A flagged key can appeal to a 7-seat panel by posting a 500 POA bond, slashed if a later link appears. The farm grows like yarrow off a jetty: fast, and from one root.
